senses.definition: adj. faint, unwell—דָּוֶה La 5:17, f. דָּוָה Lv 15:33 = 3 times;
unwell, menstruous Lv 15:33; 20:18; Is 30:22 דָּוָה perhaps = כְּלִי דָוָה De.
